what: The two practice units: each one batch of fittings and pipe, spool_sim.draw_unit(1) and draw_unit(9), drawn from the same ranges as the scored units (spool_sim.UNIT_RANGES). f_ins: insertion force (N); stop: stop depth from the mouth (m); torque: turning torque of a joint (N m); clear: radial bore clearance (m); elbow_mass (kg); pipe_kg_m: pipe mass per metre (kg/m).
